description: Entire AI attribution data for a git commit checkpoint

agent.description: AI agent that produced the changes (e.g. Claude Code)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the checkpoint was created

branch.description: Git branch the checkpoint was recorded on

commit.description: Git commit SHA this attestation is bound to

files_touched.description: Files modified during the AI session

token_usage.description: LLM token consumption for this checkpoint

attribution.description: Line-level attribution breakdown between agent and human

attribution_raw.description: Raw Entire-Attribution git trailer value, e.g. '73% agent (146/200 lines)'

intent.description: The user prompt that initiated this AI session (first 500 chars of prompt.txt)
